files.prompt_en: A full-body character sprite for a hand-painted fantasy exploration RPG. One sea king who personally repairs the ruined gate of his homeland, a broad-shouldered older humanoid with a weathered face, warm gray-brown skin, swept-back silver hair and a short silver beard. He faces three-quarters toward the viewer with a steady, tired, attentive expression. He wears a simple narrow iron circlet, a faded deep sea-blue working robe with rolled sleeves, a brown leather work apron, dark trousers and sturdy boots. Both empty hands are relaxed and clearly visible near waist level, ready to speak with travelers. The character and clothing alone form one clear readable silhouette. Natural proportions, restrained painted linework, softly brushed textures, soft directional light, muted colors of slate, oxidized iron and deep sea blue. Center the complete figure on a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas, with head, circlet, hands and both boot tips fully framed and generous transparent margins. The entire surrounding canvas is transparent.
files.prompt_ja: 手描きの探索RPG用の全身立ち絵。崩壊した故郷の城門を自ら補修する海王が一人。肩幅のある年配の人型で、風雨にさらされた顔、温かみのある灰褐色の肌、後ろへ流した銀髪と短い銀のひげ。斜め正面を向き、疲れを帯びながらも落ち着いて相手を見る。細い鉄の額輪、袖をまくった色褪せた海青色の作業衣、茶色の革の前掛け、暗色のズボン、丈夫なブーツを身に着ける。両手は空にして腰の近くへ自然に下ろし、旅人との対話に使える姿勢。人物と衣装だけがひとつの明瞭な輪郭を作る。自然な体の比率、控えめな筆線、柔らかな塗りと斜光、石板と酸化鉄と深い海青色の落ち着いた配色。1024×1536の縦長画面の中央に全身を置き、頭と額輪、両手、ブーツの先まで収め、周囲に十分な透明の余白を取る。背景全体は透明。
